podcast.body: Released on April 27, 2011, more than a year and a half later than originally planned for "Part One," this became the "last ever Beastie Boys album." The album's release and promotion were significantly impacted by Adam Yauch's ongoing battle with cancer, preventing a tour and his appearance in any of the album's videos. "Make some noise from the last ever Beastie Boys album, Hot Sauce Committee Part Two."

podcast.body: This is a re-edition of "hot shows committee patchuk," likely "Hot Sauce Committee Part Two," one of three Beastie Boys albums being re-edited on December 8th. This album holds particular significance as it was the last release from the Beastie Boys before the death of one of its members. "hot shows committee patchuk, fue lo último que tuvimos en los bistiboyos antes de la muerte de uno de ellos."
